descriptions.w3d_retreat_construct_8010dadc: Constructs a retreat state and clears its actor and state fields.
descriptions.w3d_retreat_destroy_8010db24: Releases the held actor and destroys the retreat base state.
descriptions.w3d_retreat_tick_8010dc0c: Advances the retreat delay and clears the actor field when the delay expires.
descriptions.w3d_retreat_launch_8010dd44: Posts a powering-up message and starts the retreat delay once.
descriptions.w3d_surrender_construct_8010df80: Constructs the surrender state and clears its launch and token fields.
descriptions.w3d_surrender_destroy_8010dfc8: Releases the held token and destroys the surrender base state.
descriptions.w3d_surrender_tick_8010e0b0: Posts surrender and end-turn messages after the delay and releases the held token.
descriptions.w3d_surrender_reset_8010e22c: Clears retreat time, releases the held token and resets its timestamp.
descriptions.w3d_surrender_launch_8010e298: Starts surrender, acquires an optional token and posts weapon action messages.
